programme.title: Tom Kerridge Cooks...
programme.desc: Tom Kerridge is on the road in Central Italy meeting producers who are as obsessed with growing ingredients as he is about cooking them. In his bespoke, vintage food truck he gets stuck foraging truffles in Umbria before discovering how the Campanian Plain has been a hotbed of agricultural innovation for thousands of years, something he sees in today's precision herb farms. In a forest whose location is a closely-kept secret, he joins Alessandro and his dogs Moretta and Nena on the hunt for Black Gold! Tom cooks up a feast to say thank you - an indulgent, delicious truffle mac 'n' cheese. His journey then takes him to the ancient ruins of Paestum, a city born out of agricultural innovation, something the Campanian Plain is still at the cutting edge of today. He joins Guillermo to turn his hand to the carefully created lines of a precision farm that lead the way in the 21st century. After a hard day's work Tom cooks baked cod with parsley butter, gremolata and saffron rice to celebrate.

programme.title: Force Of Nature
programme.desc: Documentary series revealing the incredible ways in which all life is impacted by our journey around the Sun. As climate change accelerates, weather across the planet is becoming more extreme, more violent, and less predictable - a burrowing owl mother on the American prairies must use her extraordinary hearing and a network of underground burrows to save her scattered chicks from intensifying tornadoes, two veteran cheetah brothers in Kenya face record-breaking floods that force them to swim raging rivers and confront deadly rivals before one hunting alone uses the storms to his advantage, a young polar bear in the Arctic loses the summer sea ice she depends on and is driven to stalk reindeer on land, and a troop of chimpanzees in drought-stricken Senegal dig wells and descend into abandoned gold mines in a desperate search for water. These animals across a warming world reveal resilience, ingenuity and courage, but adaptation has limits in the face of relentless change.

programme.desc: Documentary series revealing the incredible ways in which all life is impacted by our journey around the Sun. As the planet’s shifting rain patterns rewrite the rules, survival is no longer about strength alone - it is about timing, instinct, and the courage to move forwards when faced with rising flood waters. From the desert to the jungle, three mothers face the ultimate test of survival - monsoon floodwaters tear through pygmy elephant territory in the rainforests of Borneo as a mother must lead her calf across a raging river to get to higher ground, and a female platypus in Australia watches a flash flood destroy her home river in a single day. With breeding season looming, the platypus abandons her home and ventures into the human world on a desperate journey to find a new river in time to lay her eggs - elsewhere, a flood in the middle of the desert in Africa brings bountiful prey for a lone lioness raising eight cubs who uses sand and water to trap buffalo five times her size.

programme.title: Tom Kerridge Cooks...
programme.desc: Tom Kerridge is on the road in Central Italy meeting producers who are as obsessed with growing ingredients as he is about cooking them. In his bespoke, vintage food truck he gets stuck foraging truffles in Umbria before discovering how the Campanian Plain has been a hotbed of agricultural innovation for thousands of years, something he sees in today's precision herb farms. In a forest whose location is a closely-kept secret, he joins Alessandro and his dogs Moretta and Nena on the hunt for Black Gold! Tom cooks up a feast to say thank you - an indulgent, delicious truffle mac 'n' cheese. His journey then takes him to the ancient ruins of Paestum, a city born out of agricultural innovation, something the Campanian Plain is still at the cutting edge of today. He joins Guillermo to turn his hand to the carefully created lines of a precision farm that lead the way in the 21st century. After a hard day's work Tom cooks baked cod with parsley butter, gremolata and saffron rice to celebrate.

programme.title: Force Of Nature
programme.desc: Documentary series revealing the incredible ways in which all life is impacted by our journey around the Sun. As climate change accelerates, weather across the planet is becoming more extreme, more violent, and less predictable - a burrowing owl mother on the American prairies must use her extraordinary hearing and a network of underground burrows to save her scattered chicks from intensifying tornadoes, two veteran cheetah brothers in Kenya face record-breaking floods that force them to swim raging rivers and confront deadly rivals before one hunting alone uses the storms to his advantage, a young polar bear in the Arctic loses the summer sea ice she depends on and is driven to stalk reindeer on land, and a troop of chimpanzees in drought-stricken Senegal dig wells and descend into abandoned gold mines in a desperate search for water. These animals across a warming world reveal resilience, ingenuity and courage, but adaptation has limits in the face of relentless change.

programme.title: The Chase Celebrity Special
programme.desc: Bradley Walsh hosts as former Strictly Come Dancing judge Len Goodman, presenter Nicki Chapman, The Repair Shop's Will Kirk and comedian Joe Pasquale take on the challenge and hope to win thousands of pounds for their charities.

programme.title: The Chase Around The World
programme.desc: The Chase Around The World is a six-part series where Bradley and The Chasers escape the studio to challenge contestants on the world's smartest road trip; Six pairs set off on an epic chase around some of the world's most incredible cities, aiming to win the £100,000 prize. The teams land in Lisbon to take on The Dark Destroyer and The Sinnerman, who have set a series of quiz questions that the teams must solve to navigate across the city and find Bradley at the finish line. Competition is fierce as teams do not want to finish last, if they do they face a head-to-head showdown with the Chasers. The final pair will need to beat them to join the other teams and head onto the next city - lose and it's the first flight home. The episode begins with an exciting high-speed quiz on speedboats and the race across the city forces the teams to navigate their way to the finish line by successfully completing games involving custard tarts, tins of sardines, phone boxes and tuk-tuks.

programme.title: The Chase Around The World
programme.desc: The Chase Around The World is a six-part series where Bradley and The Chasers escape the studio to challenge contestants on the world's smartest road trip; Six pairs set off on an epic chase around some of the world's most incredible cities, aiming to win the £100,000 prize. programme.title: Force Of Nature
programme.desc: Documentary series revealing the incredible ways in which all life is impacted by our journey around the Sun. As the planet’s shifting rain patterns rewrite the rules, survival is no longer about strength alone - it is about timing, instinct, and the courage to move forwards when faced with rising flood waters. From the desert to the jungle, three mothers face the ultimate test of survival - monsoon floodwaters tear through pygmy elephant territory in the rainforests of Borneo as a mother must lead her calf across a raging river to get to higher ground, and a female platypus in Australia watches a flash flood destroy her home river in a single day. With breeding season looming, the platypus abandons her home and ventures into the human world on a desperate journey to find a new river in time to lay her eggs - elsewhere, a flood in the middle of the desert in Africa brings bountiful prey for a lone lioness raising eight cubs who uses sand and water to trap buffalo five times her size.

programme.title: Van der Valk
programme.desc: Two whistleblowers are under police protection prior to a hearing that could bring down Bibi Franken, the matriarch of a criminal empire. When the first whistleblower is murdered, the team must ensure the second makes it to court. The situation is complicated by the fact that the officer in charge of the first victim is Kalie Tenkers, Van Der Valk's former flame. When Van Der Valk himself is nearly killed in an explosion, it seems clear that Bibi is trying to derail the hearing - or is she?

As climate change accelerates, weather across the planet is becoming more extreme, more violent, and less predictable - a burrowing owl mother on the American prairies must use her extraordinary hearing and a network of underground burrows to save her scattered chicks from intensifying tornadoes, two veteran cheetah brothers in Kenya face record-breaking floods that force them to swim raging rivers and confront deadly rivals before one hunting alone uses the storms to his advantage, a young polar bear in the Arctic loses the summer sea ice she depends on and is driven to stalk reindeer on land, and a troop of chimpanzees in drought-stricken Senegal dig wells and descend into abandoned gold mines in a desperate search for water. These animals across a warming world reveal resilience, ingenuity and courage, but adaptation has limits in the face of relentless change.

programme.title: The Chase Around The World
programme.desc: The Chase Around The World is a six-part series where Bradley and The Chasers escape the studio to challenge contestants on the world's smartest road trip; Six pairs set off on an epic chase around some of the world's most incredible cities, aiming to win the £100,000 prize. The teams land in Lisbon to take on The Dark Destroyer and The Sinnerman, who have set a series of quiz questions that the teams must solve to navigate across the city and find Bradley at the finish line. Competition is fierce as teams do not want to finish last, if they do they face a head-to-head showdown with the Chasers. The final pair will need to beat them to join the other teams and head onto the next city - lose and it's the first flight home. The episode begins with an exciting high-speed quiz on speedboats and the race across the city forces the teams to navigate their way to the finish line by successfully completing games involving custard tarts, tins of sardines, phone boxes and tuk-tuks.

programme.title: Force Of Nature
programme.desc: Documentary series revealing the incredible ways in which all life is impacted by our journey around the Sun. As the planet’s shifting rain patterns rewrite the rules, survival is no longer about strength alone - it is about timing, instinct, and the courage to move forwards when faced with rising flood waters. From the desert to the jungle, three mothers face the ultimate test of survival - monsoon floodwaters tear through pygmy elephant territory in the rainforests of Borneo as a mother must lead her calf across a raging river to get to higher ground, and a female platypus in Australia watches a flash flood destroy her home river in a single day. With breeding season looming, the platypus abandons her home and ventures into the human world on a desperate journey to find a new river in time to lay her eggs - elsewhere, a flood in the middle of the desert in Africa brings bountiful prey for a lone lioness raising eight cubs who uses sand and water to trap buffalo five times her size.

programme.title: Van der Valk
programme.desc: Two whistleblowers are under police protection prior to a hearing that could bring down Bibi Franken, the matriarch of a criminal empire. When the first whistleblower is murdered, the team must ensure the second makes it to court. The situation is complicated by the fact that the officer in charge of the first victim is Kalie Tenkers, Van Der Valk's former flame. When Van Der Valk himself is nearly killed in an explosion, it seems clear that Bibi is trying to derail the hearing - or is she?

programme.desc: Mystery action thriller sequel featuring the return of Lee Child's popular literary character. programme.title: Tom Kerridge Cooks...
programme.desc: Tom Kerridge is on the road in Central Italy meeting producers who are as obsessed with growing ingredients as he is about cooking them. In his bespoke, vintage food truck he gets stuck foraging truffles in Umbria before discovering how the Campanian Plain has been a hotbed of agricultural innovation for thousands of years, something he sees in today's precision herb farms. In a forest whose location is a closely-kept secret, he joins Alessandro and his dogs Moretta and Nena on the hunt for Black Gold! Tom cooks up a feast to say thank you - an indulgent, delicious truffle mac 'n' cheese. His journey then takes him to the ancient ruins of Paestum, a city born out of agricultural innovation, something the Campanian Plain is still at the cutting edge of today. He joins Guillermo to turn his hand to the carefully created lines of a precision farm that lead the way in the 21st century. After a hard day's work Tom cooks baked cod with parsley butter, gremolata and saffron rice to celebrate.

As climate change accelerates, weather across the planet is becoming more extreme, more violent, and less predictable - a burrowing owl mother on the American prairies must use her extraordinary hearing and a network of underground burrows to save her scattered chicks from intensifying tornadoes, two veteran cheetah brothers in Kenya face record-breaking floods that force them to swim raging rivers and confront deadly rivals before one hunting alone uses the storms to his advantage, a young polar bear in the Arctic loses the summer sea ice she depends on and is driven to stalk reindeer on land, and a troop of chimpanzees in drought-stricken Senegal dig wells and descend into abandoned gold mines in a desperate search for water. These animals across a warming world reveal resilience, ingenuity and courage, but adaptation has limits in the face of relentless change.

programme.title: The Chase Celebrity Special
programme.desc: Bradley Walsh hosts as former Strictly Come Dancing judge Len Goodman, presenter Nicki Chapman, The Repair Shop's Will Kirk and comedian Joe Pasquale take on the challenge and hope to win thousands of pounds for their charities.

programme.title: The Chase Around The World
programme.desc: The Chase Around The World is a six-part series where Bradley and The Chasers escape the studio to challenge contestants on the world's smartest road trip; Six pairs set off on an epic chase around some of the world's most incredible cities, aiming to win the £100,000 prize. The teams land in Lisbon to take on The Dark Destroyer and The Sinnerman, who have set a series of quiz questions that the teams must solve to navigate across the city and find Bradley at the finish line. Competition is fierce as teams do not want to finish last, if they do they face a head-to-head showdown with the Chasers. The final pair will need to beat them to join the other teams and head onto the next city - lose and it's the first flight home. The episode begins with an exciting high-speed quiz on speedboats and the race across the city forces the teams to navigate their way to the finish line by successfully completing games involving custard tarts, tins of sardines, phone boxes and tuk-tuks.

programme.title: Force Of Nature
programme.desc: Documentary series revealing the incredible ways in which all life is impacted by our journey around the Sun. As the planet’s shifting rain patterns rewrite the rules, survival is no longer about strength alone - it is about timing, instinct, and the courage to move forwards when faced with rising flood waters. From the desert to the jungle, three mothers face the ultimate test of survival - monsoon floodwaters tear through pygmy elephant territory in the rainforests of Borneo as a mother must lead her calf across a raging river to get to higher ground, and a female platypus in Australia watches a flash flood destroy her home river in a single day. With breeding season looming, the platypus abandons her home and ventures into the human world on a desperate journey to find a new river in time to lay her eggs - elsewhere, a flood in the middle of the desert in Africa brings bountiful prey for a lone lioness raising eight cubs who uses sand and water to trap buffalo five times her size.

programme.title: Van der Valk
programme.desc: Two whistleblowers are under police protection prior to a hearing that could bring down Bibi Franken, the matriarch of a criminal empire. When the first whistleblower is murdered, the team must ensure the second makes it to court. The situation is complicated by the fact that the officer in charge of the first victim is Kalie Tenkers, Van Der Valk's former flame. When Van Der Valk himself is nearly killed in an explosion, it seems clear that Bibi is trying to derail the hearing - or is she?

programme.title: Tom Kerridge Cooks...
programme.desc: Tom Kerridge is on the road in Central Italy meeting producers who are as obsessed with growing ingredients as he is about cooking them. In his bespoke, vintage food truck he gets stuck foraging truffles in Umbria before discovering how the Campanian Plain has been a hotbed of agricultural innovation for thousands of years, something he sees in today's precision herb farms. In a forest whose location is a closely-kept secret, he joins Alessandro and his dogs Moretta and Nena on the hunt for Black Gold! Tom cooks up a feast to say thank you - an indulgent, delicious truffle mac 'n' cheese. His journey then takes him to the ancient ruins of Paestum, a city born out of agricultural innovation, something the Campanian Plain is still at the cutting edge of today. He joins Guillermo to turn his hand to the carefully created lines of a precision farm that lead the way in the 21st century. After a hard day's work Tom cooks baked cod with parsley butter, gremolata and saffron rice to celebrate.

programme.desc: Tom Kerridge is on the road in Central Italy meeting producers who are as obsessed with growing ingredients as he is about cooking them. In his bespoke, vintage food truck he gets stuck foraging truffles in Umbria before discovering how the Campanian Plain has been a hotbed of agricultural innovation for thousands of years, something he sees in today's precision herb farms. In a forest whose location is a closely-kept secret, he joins Alessandro and his dogs Moretta and Nena on the hunt for Black Gold! Tom cooks up a feast to say thank you - an indulgent, delicious truffle mac 'n' cheese. His journey then takes him to the ancient ruins of Paestum, a city born out of agricultural innovation, something the Campanian Plain is still at the cutting edge of today. He joins Guillermo to turn his hand to the carefully created lines of a precision farm that lead the way in the 21st century. After a hard day's work Tom cooks baked cod with parsley butter, gremolata and saffron rice to celebrate.

programme.title: Force Of Nature
programme.desc: Documentary series revealing the incredible ways in which all life is impacted by our journey around the Sun. As the planet’s shifting rain patterns rewrite the rules, survival is no longer about strength alone - it is about timing, instinct, and the courage to move forwards when faced with rising flood waters. From the desert to the jungle, three mothers face the ultimate test of survival - monsoon floodwaters tear through pygmy elephant territory in the rainforests of Borneo as a mother must lead her calf across a raging river to get to higher ground, and a female platypus in Australia watches a flash flood destroy her home river in a single day. With breeding season looming, the platypus abandons her home and ventures into the human world on a desperate journey to find a new river in time to lay her eggs - elsewhere, a flood in the middle of the desert in Africa brings bountiful prey for a lone lioness raising eight cubs who uses sand and water to trap buffalo five times her size.

programme.title: Tom Kerridge Cooks...
programme.desc: Tom Kerridge is on the road in Central Italy meeting producers who are as obsessed with growing ingredients as he is about cooking them. In his bespoke, vintage food truck he gets stuck foraging truffles in Umbria before discovering how the Campanian Plain has been a hotbed of agricultural innovation for thousands of years, something he sees in today's precision herb farms. In a forest whose location is a closely-kept secret, he joins Alessandro and his dogs Moretta and Nena on the hunt for Black Gold! Tom cooks up a feast to say thank you - an indulgent, delicious truffle mac 'n' cheese. His journey then takes him to the ancient ruins of Paestum, a city born out of agricultural innovation, something the Campanian Plain is still at the cutting edge of today. He joins Guillermo to turn his hand to the carefully created lines of a precision farm that lead the way in the 21st century. After a hard day's work Tom cooks baked cod with parsley butter, gremolata and saffron rice to celebrate.

programme.title: Force Of Nature
programme.desc: Documentary series revealing the incredible ways in which all life is impacted by our journey around the Sun. As climate change accelerates, weather across the planet is becoming more extreme, more violent, and less predictable - a burrowing owl mother on the American prairies must use her extraordinary hearing and a network of underground burrows to save her scattered chicks from intensifying tornadoes, two veteran cheetah brothers in Kenya face record-breaking floods that force them to swim raging rivers and confront deadly rivals before one hunting alone uses the storms to his advantage, a young polar bear in the Arctic loses the summer sea ice she depends on and is driven to stalk reindeer on land, and a troop of chimpanzees in drought-stricken Senegal dig wells and descend into abandoned gold mines in a desperate search for water. These animals across a warming world reveal resilience, ingenuity and courage, but adaptation has limits in the face of relentless change.

programme.title: The Chase Around The World
programme.desc: The Chase Around The World is a six-part series where Bradley and The Chasers escape the studio to challenge contestants on the world's smartest road trip; Six pairs set off on an epic chase around some of the world's most incredible cities, aiming to win the £100,000 prize. The teams land in Lisbon to take on The Dark Destroyer and The Sinnerman, who have set a series of quiz questions that the teams must solve to navigate across the city and find Bradley at the finish line. Competition is fierce as teams do not want to finish last, if they do they face a head-to-head showdown with the Chasers. The final pair will need to beat them to join the other teams and head onto the next city - lose and it's the first flight home. The episode begins with an exciting high-speed quiz on speedboats and the race across the city forces the teams to navigate their way to the finish line by successfully completing games involving custard tarts, tins of sardines, phone boxes and tuk-tuks.

programme.title: Force Of Nature
programme.desc: Documentary series revealing the incredible ways in which all life is impacted by our journey around the Sun. As the planet’s shifting rain patterns rewrite the rules, survival is no longer about strength alone - it is about timing, instinct, and the courage to move forwards when faced with rising flood waters. From the desert to the jungle, three mothers face the ultimate test of survival - monsoon floodwaters tear through pygmy elephant territory in the rainforests of Borneo as a mother must lead her calf across a raging river to get to higher ground, and a female platypus in Australia watches a flash flood destroy her home river in a single day. With breeding season looming, the platypus abandons her home and ventures into the human world on a desperate journey to find a new river in time to lay her eggs - elsewhere, a flood in the middle of the desert in Africa brings bountiful prey for a lone lioness raising eight cubs who uses sand and water to trap buffalo five times her size.

programme.desc: Tom Kerridge is on the road in Central Italy meeting producers who are as obsessed with growing ingredients as he is about cooking them. In his bespoke, vintage food truck he gets stuck foraging truffles in Umbria before discovering how the Campanian Plain has been a hotbed of agricultural innovation for thousands of years, something he sees in today's precision herb farms. In a forest whose location is a closely-kept secret, he joins Alessandro and his dogs Moretta and Nena on the hunt for Black Gold! Tom cooks up a feast to say thank you - an indulgent, delicious truffle mac 'n' cheese. His journey then takes him to the ancient ruins of Paestum, a city born out of agricultural innovation, something the Campanian Plain is still at the cutting edge of today. He joins Guillermo to turn his hand to the carefully created lines of a precision farm that lead the way in the 21st century. After a hard day's work Tom cooks baked cod with parsley butter, gremolata and saffron rice to celebrate.

programme.title: Force Of Nature
programme.desc: Documentary series revealing the incredible ways in which all life is impacted by our journey around the Sun. As climate change accelerates, weather across the planet is becoming more extreme, more violent, and less predictable - a burrowing owl mother on the American prairies must use her extraordinary hearing and a network of underground burrows to save her scattered chicks from intensifying tornadoes, two veteran cheetah brothers in Kenya face record-breaking floods that force them to swim raging rivers and confront deadly rivals before one hunting alone uses the storms to his advantage, a young polar bear in the Arctic loses the summer sea ice she depends on and is driven to stalk reindeer on land, and a troop of chimpanzees in drought-stricken Senegal dig wells and descend into abandoned gold mines in a desperate search for water. These animals across a warming world reveal resilience, ingenuity and courage, but adaptation has limits in the face of relentless change.
